title: Recreational Cannabis | BUZZY
description: BUZZY's own explanations of adult-use cannabis in New York, quoted with links to each source article.
lede: What BUZZY has written about buying adult-use cannabis in Brooklyn, with a link to each article.

blocks.html: Cannabis is legal for adults 21+ in New York City.
blocks.sourceTitle: Buzzy Brooklyn Dispensary: Frequently Asked Questions

blocks.html: Brooklyn follows the same adult-use cannabis laws as the rest of New York State.
blocks.sourceTitle: Is Weed Legal in New York? A Brooklyn Guide to Legal Cannabis

blocks.html: Adult-use cannabis can only be sold to people who are 21 or older. Licensed dispensary staff are required to check identification before completing a cannabis purchase.
blocks.sourceTitle: What Do You Need to Buy Weed in Brooklyn? ID, Age & Dispensary Basics

blocks.html: The simplest approach is to bring a current government-issued photo ID that clearly shows your date of birth.
blocks.sourceTitle: What Do You Need to Buy Weed in Brooklyn? ID, Age & Dispensary Basics

blocks.html: For adults 21 and older, New York’s headline possession limit is easy to remember: up to 3 ounces of cannabis and up to 24 grams of concentrated cannabis outside the home.
blocks.sourceTitle: New York Cannabis Limits: A Guide to Possession and Purchase

blocks.html: A dispensary cannot legally sell you an amount that would put the transaction outside applicable state limits.
blocks.sourceTitle: What Do You Need to Buy Weed in Brooklyn? ID, Age & Dispensary Basics

blocks.html: Cannabis is legal for adults 21 and older in New York, but that does not mean you can smoke or vape it everywhere in Brooklyn or New York City.
blocks.sourceTitle: Where Can You Smoke Weed in Brooklyn & NYC?

blocks.html: Smoking and vaping cannabis are prohibited in New York City parks.
blocks.sourceTitle: Where Can You Smoke Weed in Brooklyn & NYC?

blocks.html: Cannabis smoking and vaping are prohibited in motor vehicles, even if the vehicle is parked.
blocks.sourceTitle: Where Can You Smoke Weed in Brooklyn & NYC?

blocks.html: If you are visiting Brooklyn or New York City and are 21 or older, you can purchase adult-use cannabis from a licensed New York dispensary.
blocks.sourceTitle: Can Tourists Buy Weed in Brooklyn? What NYC Visitors Should Know

blocks.html: Do not take cannabis across state lines or international borders.
blocks.sourceTitle: Can Tourists Buy Weed in Brooklyn? What NYC Visitors Should Know

blocks.html: Adult-use cannabis delivery is limited to customers 21+. New York requires age verification as part of the order process and an additional identification check when the delivery is completed.
blocks.sourceTitle: Cannabis Delivery in Brooklyn: What You Need to Know

blocks.html: New York OCM guidance states that delivery orders must be prepaid online or by phone and that cash cannot be accepted by a delivery employee at the time of delivery.
blocks.sourceTitle: Cannabis Delivery in Brooklyn: What You Need to Know
